item.name: Retrieve a Player with Name and NFL Team

request.description:
## Retrieve a Player with Name and NFL Team

Retrieves detailed information about a specific NFL player by their name and team abbreviation. Use this endpoint to look up a player's data when you know both their full name and the team they play for.

---

### HTTP Method & URL

```
GET {{base_url}}/api/player/team/{team}?name={playerName}

 ```

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `team` | string | Yes | The NFL team abbreviation (e.g., `BUF` for Buffalo Bills, `KC` for Kansas City Chiefs). |

---

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | The full name of the player to retrieve (e.g., `Josh Allen`). |

---

### Example Request

``` http
GET http://localhost:8081/api/player/team/BUF?name=Josh Allen

 ```

---

### Example Responses

#### 200 — Successful Retrieval of Player

Returned when the player is found on the specified team.

``` json
{
  "status": "SUCCESS",
  "message": "Player retrieved successfully",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-26T18:53:12.953706900Z",
  "data": {
    "name": "Josh Allen",
    "team": "BUF"
  }
}

 ```

#### 404 — Failure of Player That Does Not Exist

Returned when the specified player cannot be found on the given team.

``` json
{
  "status": "ERROR",
  "message": "Player 'Random Player' not found on team",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-26T18:53:12.953706900Z",
  "data": null
}

 ```

## Retrieve a Player with its ID

---

 ```

---

### Path Parameters

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | Yes | The unique identifier of the player (e.g., `78` for Chris Olave). |

---

 ```

item.name: Retrieve Analysis of a Player with its ID

request.description:
## Retrieve Analysis of a Player with its ID

Retrieves a detailed fantasy analysis for a specific NFL player by their unique ID. Use this endpoint to evaluate a player's fantasy value, including their scare score, tier rating, and supporting explanations.

---

### HTTP Method & URL

```
GET {{base_url}}/api/player/{id}/analysis

 ```

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | Yes | The unique identifier of the player (e.g., `22` for Bijan Robinson). |

---

### Example Request

``` http
GET http://localhost:8081/api/player/22/analysis

 ```

---

### Example Responses

#### 200 — Successful Retrieval of Player Analysis

Returned when the player is found and their analysis is available.

``` json
{
  "status": "SUCCESS",
  "message": "Operation successful",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-26T20:13:13.089545200Z",
  "data": {
    "name": "Bijan Robinson",
    "nfl_team": "ATL",
    "position": "RB",
    "scare_score": 92.41,
    "scare_tier": "ELITE",
    "primary_explanation": "Highly productive lead runner with strong overall metrics.",
    "supporting_explanations": [
      "Lethal red zone threat; consistently finishes drives.",
      "Elite receiving back; a vital mismatch in the passing game."
    ]
  }
}

 ```

#### 404 — Failure of Player ID That Does Not Exist

Returned when no player can be found with the given ID.

``` json
{
  "status": "ERROR",
  "message": "Player with ID '0' not found",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-26T20:13:13.089545200Z",
  "data": null
}

 ```

item.name: Run Monte Carlo Simulation for a Player

request.description:
StartFragment

## Run Monte Carlo Simulation for a Player by ID

Executes a Monte Carlo simulation for a specific NFL player using 10,000 iterations to project their range of fantasy outcomes. Use this endpoint to evaluate a player’s volatility, including their average, ceiling, floor, and boom/bust probabilities.

---

### HTTP Method & URL

```
GET {{base_url}}/api/player/{id}/simulation

 ```

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | Yes | The unique identifier of the player (e.g., `34` for Josh Jacobs). |

---

### Example Request

``` http
GET http://localhost:8081/api/player/34/simulation

 ```

---

### Example Responses

#### 200 — Successful Simulation Execution

Returned when the player is found and the Monte Carlo simulation is successfully executed.

``` json
{
  "status": "SUCCESS",
  "message": "Operation successful",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-30T22:08:05.752544600Z",
  "data": {
    "name": "Josh Jacobs",
    "nfl_team": "GB",
    "position": "RB",
    "scare_tier": "SCARY",
    "avg_scare_score": 86.42,
    "best_scare_score": 98.74,
    "worst_scare_score": 76.9,
    "boom_percentage": 7.89,
    "bust_percentage": 0.15
  }
}

 ```

#### 404 — Failure of Player ID That Does Not Exist

Returned when no player can be found with the given ID.

``` json
{
  "status": "ERROR",
  "message": "Player with ID '0' not found",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-30T22:08:05.752544600Z",
  "data": null
}

 ```

EndFragment

request.description:
## Retrieve All Players (Paginated)

Retrieves a paginated list of NFL players along with their current and previous season statistics. This endpoint supports pagination and is typically used as the starting point for browsing or selecting players.

---

### HTTP Method & URL

```
GET {{base_url}}/api/player

 ```

---

### Query Parameters (Optional)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | integer | No | The page number to retrieve (default is `0`). |
| `size` | integer | No | Number of players per page (default is `10`). |
| `position` | string | No | Sorting criteria based on position. |

---

### Example Request

``` http
GET {{base_url}}/api/player?page=0&size=10

 ```

---

### Example Responses

#### 200 OK — Players Retrieved Successfully

Returned when a paginated list of players is successfully retrieved.

item.name: Create a Fantasy Team with a Roster

request.description:
## Create Fantasy Team

Creates a new fantasy team by selecting a roster of NFL players. The endpoint validates roster composition rules (such as position limits) and returns the created team with enriched player data.

---

### HTTP Method & URL

```
POST {{base_url}}/api/team/create

 ```

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | Name of the fantasy team |
| `roster` | array | Yes | List of players to include in the team |
| `roster[].name` | string | Yes | Player name |
| `roster[].team` | string | Yes | NFL team abbreviation |

---

### Example Request

``` json
{
  "name": "Ultimate Fantasy Team",
  "roster": [
    { "name": "Lamar Jackson", "team": "BAL" },
    { "name": "Bijan Robinson", "team": "ATL" },
    { "name": "Saquon Barkley", "team": "PHI" },
    { "name": "CeeDee Lamb", "team": "DAL" },
    { "name": "Puka Nacua", "team": "LAR" },
    { "name": "Brock Bowers", "team": "LV" },
    { "name": "Justin Jefferson", "team": "MIN" }
  ]
}

 ```

---

### Example Responses

#### 200 OK — Team Created Successfully

Returned when the team is successfully created and all players are valid.

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | Yes | The unique identifier of the team |

---

### Example Request

GET {{base_url}}/api/team/11

## Get Team Matchup By ID

Retrieves a previously generated team matchup analysis, including team scores, win probabilities, and all individual player matchups.

---

### HTTP Method & URL

```
GET {{base_url}}/api/matchup/team/{id}

 ```

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | Yes | Unique identifier of the team matchup |

GET http://localhost:8081/api/matchup/team/2
